text.answer: Blinding Assault sends Valor forward until he hits an enemy, dealing physical damage around the impact and marking the primary target with Harrier. The primary target is briefly nearsighted if a champion, reducing their sight radius, or disarmed otherwise.
text.counterplay: Dodge Valor's path and play cautiously if your vision is reduced.

text.counterplay: Expect a marked attack after her bounce and look for an opening after Vault is used.

text.answer: Behind Enemy Lines channels to unite Quinn with Valor for greatly increased movement speed. Attacking or casting Blinding Assault or Vault triggers Skystrike, ending the flight with nearby physical damage and Harrier marks. Non-minion damage temporarily removes the speed boost; immobilization, grounding, or silence ends the flight without Skystrike.
text.counterplay: Watch roaming routes; damage can slow her approach, while immobilization, grounding, or silence can end her flight.
